title: In this world, a clock over your head counts down to your next hug
description:
In this world, everyone has a little clock over their head that counts down to their next hug. Mine has always been blank, and that suits me fine.

My girlfriend Lena keeps bees on the hill. In two years I've never gone past the gate of her yard. This week her clock started counting hours, and a man I'd never seen started standing among the hives.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: What would the clock over your head say right now?
